title: Small Business Saturday
seo_title: Small Business Saturday in Bolivar, MO – Nov 28, 2026
description: Small Business Saturday is a shopping day at Back Road Relics, where the shop will be restocked and fresh baked cookies and punch are offered all day. The shop says it is their only bonus shopping day of the year and has a couple of surprises planned. It takes place on November 28, 2026 (Time TBD) at 211 W Broadway St in Bolivar, MO.
